issues.title: Bug hunt log (2026-10-29): findings on the PR #37 integration
issues.body:
This issue logs bugs and security issues found while hunting on the integrated PR #37 branch (`claude/ghostpay-autonomous-completion-y4sk2h`). Each new finding is added as a comment when it is found. Fixes go to the PR branch with a regression test that fails before the fix.

This is AI-assisted review (Claude Code). It is not a professional audit. The audit 24 findings and the open review follow-ups are tracked in `docs/audits/24-ai-assisted-security-audit-2026-10-28.md`. The prioritised open work is in `docs/handoffs/HANDOFF_FOR_NEXT_AGENT_2026-10-29.md`.

## Findings so far

| # | Severity | Area | Finding | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Minor (key loss) | seller keys | Suppose another tab deletes vault V1, the only copy of the loaded keys, and saves V2. Unlocking V2 then replaced the loaded keys without the "no backup" confirmation, because the check read a cached backup state (C-R12, raised by the CR2 review). | **Fixed** in `2fcab7f`: the unlock re-reads the vault, asks first, and the library refuses without confirmation. Covered by 2 tests that fail before the fix. |
| 2 | Process | branches | The recovered source the consolidation recorded as missing (`fac0fbd`, `405c168`, tree `a1478b2c`) is now on GitHub. Another agent pushed it on 2026-10-28, to `ghostpay-cloud-recovery-2026-10-26`, `ghostpay-local-lean-boundary-20261027`, `codex/ghostpay-recovered-lean-checkpoint-20261028` and related branches. It holds unique seller-key completion and recovery work and acceptance tests that PR #37 lacks. | **Not merged.** A merge rehearsal hit 13 conflicts, and the audit fixes changed the same files since, so it needs a file-by-file port. The plan is in the handoff, section P1a. |

## Checked and cleared
- The idle lock now wipes the keys held by the BTC/Solana/TRON views (`9a00a7a`). This is by design: those test-network views already wipe their keys when the user leaves them, and they tell the user to write down the seed.
- The merged locale catalogs (en/es/ja/ar) have no duplicate keys. `scripts/i18n/extract.mjs` reports 0 keys missing from `en.json`.

retrieval_note: Bounded final census, retrieved across three GitHub pages at approximately 08:49 UTC; exact page retrieval timestamps were not recorded. Later PR activity is not claimed included.
